projects.title: Multimodal Character Generation
projects.description: Advanced multimodal AI system combining Wan diffusion model for video generation and Dia voice model for emotion-controlled speech synthesis. Generates coherent 720p videos with realistic voice synthesis.
highlights: Generated coherent 5-second 720p videos by fine-tuning Wan 14B + LoRA in PyTorch on custom dataset
Achieved realistic emotion-controlled speech by conditioning Dia 1.6B TTS model from Hugging Face

projects.title: LiftCrew
projects.description: A gym community app that connects fitness enthusiasts to find workout partners, share routines, and track progress together. Features real-time workout sessions, community challenges, and social features designed for gym-goers.
highlights: Building real-time workout session sharing with live activity updates
Designing social features for gym partner matching

projects.title: EHR for Doctors
projects.description: A modern Electronic Health Records platform designed for healthcare providers. Streamlines patient management, appointment scheduling, medical history tracking, and secure document handling with HIPAA-compliant architecture.
highlights: Building HIPAA-compliant patient data management system
Implementing secure appointment scheduling and reminders
Designing intuitive medical history tracking interface

projects.title: AirTune
projects.description: A native macOS app that brings Dynamic Island-style notifications and media controls to MacBooks. Features now-playing widgets, system alerts, and customizable interactions in an elegant floating interface inspired by iOS.
highlights: Building Dynamic Island-style floating interface for macOS
Implementing now-playing media controls and visualizations

projects.title: Tessa
projects.description: AI powered web app that generates relevant tweets from code commits. Increased user engagement by generating AI tweets with 92% relevance using a Python RAG pipeline. Validated monetization by converting users into 30+ paid customers using Stripe webhook subscriptions.
highlights: Reduced LLM hallucinations 75% and achieved 90% relevant tweets via RAG with structured code search tool
Deployed Llama 3.1B via Dockerized FastAPI with optimized prompts using few-shot and CoT reasoning

projects.title: OnePrediction
projects.description: iOS app with AI scoring for competing against users on soccer match predictions. Drove engagement for 5K+ users by enabling real-time AI scoring and Redis leaderboards. Shipped features 75% faster by automating AWS deployments with Terraform, Docker and Kubernetes.
highlights: Drove engagement for 5K+ users by enabling real-time algorithmic scoring and Redis leaderboards in TypeScript
Reduced search time 80% by syncing Postgres to Elasticsearch for fast full-text discovery
Shipped features 75% faster by building CI/CD pipelines with Terraform, Docker and Kubernetes on AWS

projects.title: PlaySync
projects.description: Universal music sharing platform enabling cross-platform playlist collaboration across Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube Music. Features real-time collaboration, smart song matching, and secure authentication.

projects.title: Turf Booking Platform
projects.description: High-performance turf booking system with real-time notifications and payment integration. Ranked in top 25 sports apps with map integration, universal links, and video streaming capabilities.

projects.title: Advanced Image Processing Suite
projects.description: Comprehensive image processing application with GUI and CLI interfaces, featuring color channel analysis, transformations, advanced filters, and batch processing. Built with MVC architecture.

projects.title: Sound Sage
projects.description: Advanced music recommendation system using Spotify's 12M-song dataset. Implements K-Nearest Neighbors for personalized suggestions based on audio features including valence, tempo, and danceability.

projects.title: Escape The Castle
projects.description: Intelligent agents for game playing using Model-Based and Model-Free Monte Carlo methods. Demonstrates enhanced learning efficiency and flexible adaptation to dynamic environments.

projects.title: AI Grid Coloring
projects.description: AI agent solving complex grid coloring problems using Hill Climbing algorithm. Optimizes grid coloring while minimizing color usage and brush shape variety through adaptive strategies.

projects.title: TokenSale Platform
projects.description: Decentralized token sale platform facilitating 500+ secure transactions through MetaMask. Features custom ERC-20 token smart contract on Ethereum for asset tokenization.
